headline: Trump says he will create an AI Force and appoint an AI czar
summary: Four outlets report Trump saying he will create an AI Force and appoint an AI czar, announced on Truth Social with almost no detail, as calls to slow AI development grew across politics and the industry. One adds that he suggested renaming AI and called the backlash a Democratic hoax without evidence. The outlets differ in framing, one describing the body neutrally and another as newly made-up.
